topics.bodyHtml:
This thread and its content are a pre-CBT non-final initial version for preliminary review, potentially unrelated to the final version, and can/will be changed/edited (including additions and deletions) at any time.
The content of the thread can/will be changed/edited (including additions and deletions) at any time.

Yellow text indicates points that are "new" and have not been described before (i.e. what has changed since the last project).

ConceptRatesClass and race skill changesDrop changes

CONCEPT:

  • Server client - 2.2.3.2
  • Server protection - Cerberus
  • 3 phases with a maximum level - 65 (Phase 1 up to level 50, Phase 2 up to level 55, Phase 3 up to level 65).
    • The concept of "Stages", which is a mini-phase every two weeks.
      • We have heard your positive and not-so-positive feedback regarding stage-based development. The main "pro" points were good drop rates in dungeons, bosses, and quests updated by stages. The "con" points were the cascade devaluation of current equipment.
      • Based on your feedback, we have tried to adapt the stage-based content in such a way as to mitigate these downsides while highlighting the upsides. Currently, the concept of stages is mostly used for the gradation of quest rewards, content, and BD keys introduction, rather than "hard limits" as it was in Stage Era.
      • For example, Leon weapons are available from the first stage, however, obtaining them is very difficult, and only a few will be able to craft them. As the stages progress, obtaining them will become slightly easier, as on any server without stages, but there won't be such price collapses as there were last time.
  • "Guild brawl" [More details (will be published later)]- a unique system on a permanent basis, with the bonus for guild events.
  • Guild store for buying in-game items with guild points. [More details (will be published later)]
  • Guild Development System with individual leveling of guild effects and skills.
    [More details (will be published later)]
    • Added new "mini-Pit Bosses" (Guild PB) with unique loot "guild skill capsules" that temporary increase stats for all guild characters.
  • Added many achievements "FIRST ON CERBERUS", completing which allows you to receive Cash Shop rewards. [More details (will be published later)]
  • Unique Easter Egg quest with 2,000,000 Cash Shop reward. [More details (will be published later)]
  • Updated automatic online web-auction for selling characters, items, and resources for shop points, including to other races. [More details (will be published later)]
  • Ability to withdraw Cash Shop > real money. [More details (will be published later)]

RATES:

  • Premium does not give bonuses to experience gain. Premium gives Auto-Loot* medal + +1 speed sword. [More details (will be published later)]
    *The Auto-Loot medal does not work for turrets below level 50 (during the first week - up to 45).
  • Experience - "Dynamic" leveling rates + Catching-up System [More details (will be published later)]
  • Animus Experience: x6
  • PT/Skills: x5
  • Force: x5
  • Loot drop: x2
  • Loot pick-up speed: x2 (Auto-Loot with Premium) + Drop-level system [More details (will be published later)]

CLASS AND RACE SKILL CHANGES:

General changes (regardless of race):
  • Cross-classes are available.
  • Warrior expert skill Aid Stretching (extending duration of skill buffs) moved to basic skill.
  • Warrior basic buffs Rage and Range combined into 1 buff.
  • Ranger expert buffs Wide Range and Evasion combined into 1 buff.
  • Buff Concession:
    • Buff effect Concession has been reduced by 2 times for characters with basic Mage class. I.e., on mage tanks, the Concession buff gives half as much (Lv7 - 10%);
    • Buff effect Concession has been increased by 1.25 times for characters with basic Warrior class. I.e., on warriors, the Concession buff gives a quarter more (Lv7 - 25%).
  • Magic debuffs Weakness and Vulnerability can only be used on characters.
  • Magic debuff Enfeeblement effect decreased on levels 1-5.
  • Increased duration of almost all class buffs to 400 seconds.
  • Reduced the cooldown of Melee Bash Explosion skill to 16 seconds.
  • Added new skill Second Wind to all Warrior 2nd classes. When used, it removes all negative debuffs from the character.
  • Unique PrecisionAccuracy, accuracy, and dodge module. [More details *link* (will be available later)]
  • Reworked dodge and accuracy:
    • Increased dodge at the seventh level of the Evasion buff from 30 to 40;
    • Increased dodge in all dodge potions by +10;
    • Increased dodge in all equipment sets, not counting the officer (council) set, by +5;
    • Reduced the amount of PrecisionAccuracy in most class buffs (for exact values, see racial changes below);
    • Reduced the amount of PrecisionAccuracy in Cora magic elite buff Acuity by 3 times (for example, on level seven it was 30, now it is 10);
    • Reduced the amount of dodge in Bellato magic elite buff Agility by 3 times (for example, on level seven it was 30, now it is 10);
    • Reduced the amount of dodge in over-perf elemental jewelry. Was [atk/doj] - 26/21 27/22 28/23 29/24 30/25, became - 26/20 27/21 28/21 29/22 30/22).
Maximum possible boost of PrecisionAccuracy / dodge at level 50
  • Dodge of the target character being attacked - [ expert buff 30 (became 40) + potion 20 (became 30) + Leon bow 25 + elemental jewelry 80 + council set 25 (if not council, Palmas 15) + +6 boots 90 + Bellato magic buff Agility 30 (became 10) (if Bellato)].
  • PrecisionAccuracy of the attacking character - [ +6 gloves 105 + PrecisionAccuracy potion 30 + expert PrecisionAccuracy buff 30 ]
[*]For Bellato, the Leon bow is also used.

  • All races have 2 unique generators, increasing the character's strength. Generators have different effects and can be purchased with PVP points and Hunting Points (separately).
  • Increased survivability of level 50+ turrets.
  • Changed the mechanics of critical hit from mass attacks (works only on players; changes do not apply to monsters). Now anti-crit is calculated for each individual player hit by the mass attack. Previously, anti-crit was projected from the primary target.
  • Notable "non-skill" changes:
    • Added and implemented a new character development system - "Relics". [More details *link* (will be available later)]
      • Added the ability to upgrade relics.
        To put it simply, relics are unique power-ups that permanently increase character stats, stack with each other, and do not take up inventory space. Relics can be obtained in various ways.
    • Removed "system" miss on monsters. Previously, any direct attack had a 5% chance to miss a monster, but this function has been disabled.
    • Added a technical macro module for auto cure potions. Allows auto-use of cure potions in a macro. There is also a configurable filter for which debuffs to trigger the auto-cure macro.
    • Increased cooldown of premium cure potions 2.5sec -> 2.7sec
    • "Notable" equipment changes:
      • Added separation in ranged weapons of a certain type: bow/crossbow and pistols/machine gun:
        • Applies only to the following weapon types: Leon, PVP, Crimson, Relic. (i.e., Leon crossbow, Leon pistols, PVP crossbow, PVP machine gun, Crimson crossbow, Crimson pistols have been added).
        • Bows and pistols have: increased damage spread (increased upper damage, reduced lower damage), crit. and dodge properties.
        • Crossbow and machine gun have: low damage spread, attack and HP properties. (The lower damage limit is additionally increased)
          • Crossbow and machine gun have minimal damage spread.
        • Added Leon support staff. Has lower damage than a regular Leon staff but has universal support and survival properties.
      • Changed all two-handed warrior Leon weapons. Changed properties and damage for increased diversity between Leon warrior weapons.
      • Changed properties of the Leon staff. Reduced attack properties, increased crit properties.
      • Changed properties in relic weapons.
        • Including pistols
      • Added EPB support jewelry. Has universal support and survival properties.
        • Added additional movement speed bonuses for the Accretia race
      • Added citadel support jewelry. Has universal support and survival properties.
      • Increased damage of type-B grenade launchers and throwing weapons.
      • Added the ability to craft Palmas and Council armor with level 53 armor stats.
      • Buffed phase 2 weapons (level 51-55).
Racial changes:
All class skills information - [More details *link* (will be available later)]

DROP CHANGES:

  • Level drop loot penalty removed for all farm mobs — Lazhuardianes in Crag Mines, Turncoats in Sette Desert, all mobs on Ether, all mobs in Desert of Hunters, and all mobs that are "gathering resources" [flowers, ore, cactus]. [More details about gathering resources at the link (will be published later)]
  • Loot/farm reduced in home locations.
  • ExcelSiar revalued by 10 times = Excelsiar drop from mobs reduced by 10 times, and the amount of excelsiar required for combinations reduced by 10 times.
    • Excelsiar drop is distributed into excelsiar boxes (box with excelsiar drops first, then excelsiar drops from the box [to save inventory space]).
  • Drop-level system added. The higher your level (starting from level 50), the more loot you receive from mobs at farm locations. [More details at the link (will be published later)]
Ether Farm Changes:

Added farm gradation on Ether

Farm on Ether has been revised; the entire location is divided into conditional "farm zones" based on profitability.
Spots have been adjusted such that the farm in them differs drastically.

The most basic and lowest profit zone, let's call it "first" — these are the first hobo robots at the exit of each wharf.
The second most profitable zone — these are the so-called "second" hobo robots — Lockout Wharf, Repair Shop, Lemon Yard, Graveyard.
Third zone — White Hole.
Fourth zone — Lures Lot.
And the "tastiest" farm zone on Ether — Jacks Lot.

    In summary — farm is reduced

    • Farm balanced between different spots (reduced difference between top and average spots).
    • Farm balanced between different farm zones (Bellato, Cora, Accretia wharfs).

    In summary — farm SIGNIFICANTLY increased

topics.bodyHtml:
Chocolate and chaos quests
Exp quests
Cash shop quests



Cartella quests

Elan quests
All daily quests with a cooldown of 23 or 24 hours have a fixed cooldown of 09:00 Moscow time (06:00 GMT, 13:00 WIB).

CHOCOLATE AND CHAOS POTION QUESTS

"The Chocolate Factory" Quest
The daily quest "The Chocolate Factory" allows you to get Cash Shop Chocolate for free and with almost no cost.
Chocolate helps with character leveling for almost 2 hours every day.

Quest is available to characters level 35+ at the Foreign Vendor in HQ. Daily quest.
For completing the quest, you receive 10 pcs. of temporary Bonus Chocolate.
The duration of the Bonus Chocolate is 24 hours.


Group Quest "Chaos Alchemy"
The daily quest "Chaos Alchemy" is the perfect daily opportunity to obtain Chaos Potions at almost any available time. It is always a useful addition to any leveling party.

The quest is a group quest, available from level 40+ at the Foreign Vendor in HQ. Daily quest.
For completing the quest, you receive 2 pcs. of temporary bonus Chaos Potions.
*Duration of Bonus Chaos Potions is 24 hours.


EXP QUESTS

New daily experience quests are available for character leveling at levels 35+.
Quests are taken from the EXP Quester in HQ. Solo quests require level 40+, group quests require level 35+.


Solo EXP Quests

Daily solo experience quests are available at level 40+. To take the quest, you must purchase an "Experience Quest Coupon" for racial currency.
At each level, several* solo experience quests are available, which can be taken simultaneously. Lower-level quests give less experience than higher-level quests.

Daily solo experience quests can be taken from the EXP Quester in HQ.
*at each level (starting from 40), a new set of quests opens up that can be taken (except for level 47, which has no new set of quests)


Group EXP Quests

Daily group experience quests are available at level 35+. To take the quest, you must purchase a "Party Quest (Experience)" in the Cash Shop.
At each level, several* group experience quests are available, which can be taken simultaneously. Lower-level quests give less experience than higher-level quests.

Daily group experience quests can be taken from the Group EXP Quester in HQ.
*at each level (starting from 35), a new quest opens up that can be taken (except for levels 44, 47, and 48, which have no new quests)


Free Group EXP Quest

At level 45+, one free group quest "Deposit Information" is available. The quest is a chain of 5 tasks.
For completing each task in the chain, you receive experience (the higher your level, the less experience you receive), and for completing the entire chain, you will additionally receive a guaranteed 1% EXP capsule.

The free daily group experience quest can be taken from the EXP Quester in HQ.


Other EXP Quests

Experience can also be obtained by completing the following quests:
  • Standard experience quests (given when leveling up)
  • Cartella quests (level 37+ [at server start])
  • Adventurer quests (level 42+ [at server start])
  • Elan quests (level 49+)
Information on all these quests can be found below.


CASH SHOP QUESTS

In the in-game Cash Shop, daily quests are available at a price of 333 Cash coins. For completing each quest, you can receive valuable materials and resources.

There are 4 Cash Shop quests available with the following rewards:
  • Experience quests, level limit 35+ (a new experience quest can be taken at each level);
  • Crystal Talic quest, level limit 50+;
  • PVP points quest, level limit 50+;
  • Hunting points quest, level limit 55+.
All quests are group and daily quests.


CARTELLA QUESTS

Cartella Quests is a separate large quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Cartella quests are a set of daily quests with different difficulty levels. By completing them, you can obtain equipment, BD keys, relics, experience, and other valuable resources.

Cartella quests and the rewards from these quests are updated every stage.


ADVENTURER QUESTS

Adventurer Quests is a separate large quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Adventurer quests are daily quests taken for the item "Cactus Seeds", which can be dropped from gathering cactuses. By completing Adventurer quests, you can obtain contribution points, experience, relic parchment, and various other resources.


SOLO BD QUESTS

Solo BD quests is a separate quest module, which you can read more about *at this link*.

Solo BD quests are cooldown-free / repeatable quests (not daily), by completing which you can receive rewards the same as for completing dungeons.

Solo BD quest rewards are updated every stage.


DUNGEON QUESTS

BD quests allow you to receive increased reward for completing certain dungeons.
BD quests can be obtained:
  • sold from PVP Reward Merchant
  • from gold points quest
  • from Cartella Quest Emblems
To complete the quest, you need to finish a specific dungeon. As a reward for completing the quest, you can receive a reward box of that dungeon.
Quests from the PVP merchant and Cartella emblems are daily quests. Gold points quests have no cooldown.

More details about gold points quests:
For gold points, you can purchase a quest where if you bring a BD key - you will receive x3 quests for that specific dungeon.
Gold quests have no cooldown.


GUILD QUESTS

Guild quests are unique tasks, for the completion of which a character receives "guild experience", which can then be spent to level up guild skills. More details - *link*.

General guild quest.

The progress of the general quest is counted for all guild members. You can view the progress of the quest in the guild skills leveling menu *at this link*.
For example, a guild was given the general quest "Kill 500 Caliana". To complete such a quest, all guild players will have to kill a total of 500 Calianas in a day. This could be 1 character who kills 500 Calianas, or 10 characters who kill 50 Calianas each.

There are two types of general quests: Daily and Weekly. One daily general quest is available per day, and one weekly quest is available per week.

If the Guild does not have time to complete the general quest, then upon expiration of the completion period, the quest will be updated and the Guild will receive a new task.


Individual guild quests.

Individual guild quests are completed by each player separately. You can obtain such a quest from the Main Guild Curator in HQ.

There are two types of individual quests: Daily and Weekly. A daily quest can be obtained once a day, and a weekly one — once a week. For completing the quest, the player receives a guild experience capsule, as well as BD reward shards.

The higher the character's level, the higher the value of the guild experience capsule for completing the quest.


ELAN QUESTS

Elan quests contribute to character development in both PVP points and experience. With the new updated quests, completing these tasks has become much more pleasant and profitable.

A total of 5 quests are available for daily completion, each performed in the Beast Mountain location.
Quests can be purchased for 7.5kk from the Quest Vendor on Elan (located near the Merchant, not far from PB Taraven).

For completing each quest, you receive 0.5% experience and 45 PVP points.
Quests are daily.

topics.bodyHtml:
General information
Quests
Rewards

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Cartella Quests are important part of progression and one of the main ways to obtain equipment, dungeon keys, resources, and other valuable items.
  • Cartella Quests are daily quests (reset at 09:00 Moscow time (06:00 GMT, 13:00 WIB)).
  • Cartella Quests have different difficulty levels. The harder the quest, the greater the reward.
  • Completing quests reward is Cartella Emblems.
    • These emblems can be exchanged for a reward of your choice.
      similar to farming gold points and using them to purchase rewards
    • Emblems from a previous Stage cannot be used for rewards of the current Stage.
      i.e. you cannot exchange Stage 1.1 emblems for Stage 1.2 rewards, etc.
​

QUESTS

Quests can be obtained from the NPC Cartella Assistant in HQ, next to NPC Gatekeeper.


There are 6 difficulties of Cartella Quests:
(You can complete quests of all difficulties in one day — there are no restrictions on which ones you take.)
  • Easy Quests.     You receive 5 random easy quests.
    (You can receive rewards for only 5 Easy Quests per day [09:00–08:59 Moscow time (05:59 GMT, 12:59 WIB)]. i.e. you cannot stack easy quests and complete them all on one day; you must complete them every day to get rewards for all available quests.)
  • Easy+ Quests.     You receive 3 random easy+ quests.

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Adventurer Quests are daily quests, by completing which you receive experience, CP, relic parchment and other resources.
  • Adventurer Quests can be taken from the merchant in Sette Desert.
  • To take a random Adventurer Quest (a quest that subsequently opens the skilled and elite quest) it is necessary to have the
    "Cactus Seeds" item    .
    • Cactus seeds of the current stage drop from gathering cactuses.
    • Also Cactus Seeds trophy can be obtained from "desert remains" cactuses, which appear throughout Nadir Plain after the death of the Heroic Cactus.
      Heroic Cactus spawns in Nadir Plain at 12:10, 15:10, 21:10, 00:10 Moscow time (09:10, 12:10, 18:10, 21:10 GMT / 13:10, 16:10, 19:10, 01:10 WIB).
      If the heroic cactus was not killed within 30 minutes - the heroic cactus will disappear, but the desert remains will still appear.
    • Cactus seeds can also be listed and purchased on the web-auction.





​

 RANDOM ADVENTURER QUEST

Random adventurer quest is the initial quest in the adventurer's path. Quests can be taken starting from level 43 (at the server start).
The random quest is a solo, daily quest, by completing which you also receive the opportunity to complete skilled and elite adventurer quests.

There are several adventurer quest grades: low, medium, high.
The higher the quest grade - the more rewards you will receive for its completion. The quest grade cannot be chosen, however, the higher your level - the higher the chance that you will get a quest of a higher grade.

To take a random adventurer quest it is necessary to have the
"Cactus Seeds" item.

Random quest rewards:
  • Contributetion Points
  • Random reward (see below)
  • EXP Capsule
  • Skilled party quest scroll (50+)(used to obtain the skilled adventurer quest)
Possible random rewards:
  • Currency
  • Gold points
  • T4 envelope
  • T5 envelope [LGS]
  • Novajan's Ancient Remain
  • Gem modifier artifact 5%, 10%
  • Cactus leaf
  • Sealed Relic Part 1GR, 2GR, 3GR
  • Random relic 1GR, 2GR, 3GR
  • Leon box


SKILLED ADVENTURER QUEST

Skilled quest is the second quest in the adventurer's path, after the initial random adventurer quest. The quest can be taken from level 50.
Skilled quest is a partially-party, daily quest, by completing which you also receive the opportunity to complete the elite adventurer quest.

Skilled quest can only be taken after completing the random adventurer quest. Skilled quest has a chain of two quests.

Quest 1) Pick up x1 "Elan Seed" trophy.
x3 Elan seeds drop from heroic monsters on Elan. x5 Heroic monsters on Elan spawn every 30 minutes, starting from 00:00.

Quest 2) Pick up x1 "Desert Seed" trophy.
Desert seeds drop from the Heroic Cactus (loot is shared for everyone), which spawns in Nadir Plain.
Heroic Cactus spawns in Nadir Plain 12:10, 15:10, 21:10, 00:10 Moscow time (09:10, 12:10, 18:10, 21:10 GMT / 13:10, 16:10, 19:10, 01:10 WIB).

Skilled quest rewards:
  • Contributetion Points
  • Adventurer reward box
  • Relic parchments (depends on stage)
  • Adventurer Recommendation (x4 adventurer recommendation = x1 adventurer approval / adventurer approval is necessary for taking the elite adventurer quest)


ELITE ADVENTURER QUEST

Elite quest is the third quest in the adventurer's path, after the skilled adventurer quest. The quest can be taken from level 50.
Elite quest is a solo chain of 6 quests. Elite quest can be taken only once per stage.

Elite quest can be taken only after completing the skilled quest 4 times during the current stage.

Elite quest rewards:
  • Contributetion Points
  • Adventurer reward box
  • Relic parchments (depends on stage)

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Relics are unique permanent bonuses that increase your character’s stats and do not take inventory space.

HOW TO GET AND RECYCLE RELICS

Relics are parts of specific entities.

How to get relics:

Loot them from the entity they belong to (for PB - from PB, for monsters - from monsters, for dungeons - from dungeon rewards, etc.) (tradable)
  • Clarifications for relics that are not from PB or BD:
    • Rank Relics - given as a reward for completing "Box of Dreams" quest chain.

    • (1GR) Heart of Sand Relic - drops from gathering resource Cactus Grade 3.
    • (1GR) Heart of Ice Relic - drops from gathering resource Flowers Grade 3.

    • (1GR) Gold Relic - purchased with gold points.
    • (1GR) Greed Relic - purchased with racial currency from NPC Hero in HQ.
    • (3GR) Hunter Cactus Relic - drops from gathering resource Hunter Cactus Grade 3.

    • (4GR) Terminal Relic - drops as shards from chip.
    • (5GR) Hunter Relic - purchased with Hunting Points.
    • (5GR) Rift Hunter Relic - drops from Desert of Hunters rift.
    • (6GR) Gift of Random Goddess Relic - obtained from a Luck Blade upgraded to +7 keen talics. Luck Blade can be purchased from NPC Hero in HQ.

Obtain from Random Relic Boxes. Boxes also have grades just like relics.
  • You can get Random Relic Boxes from:
    • All relic-related entities with a small chance (tradable). (for example, from PB Dagnue you might get a Dagnue Relic (5GR) or a Random Relic Box Grade 5 [chance to drop a box from an entity is much lower than for the relic itself])
    • From recycling Sealed Relic Parts (not tradable). (see below)
    • From alternate sources (mostly from Cartella Quests and from Adventurer Quests) (not tradable)
    • Exceptions (cannot drop from boxes):
      • Rank Relics
      • (1GR) Gold Relic
      • (1GR) Greed Relic
      • (4GR) PVP Assassin Relic
      • (5GR) Hunter Relic
      • (6GR) Gift of Random Goddess Relic

Relics that were dropped from PB, monsters, BD, or from Random Relic Boxes (those that are TRADABLE) can be listed and bought on the web-auction.


Recycling relics:

Relics can be recycled into Sealed Relic Parts (not tradable) (can be stored in the bank).
Sealed Relic Parts also have grades. Recycling a Grade 1 relic gives a Grade 1 Sealed Relic Part, recycling a Grade 2 relic gives a Grade 2 Sealed Relic Part, and so on.



x3 Sealed Relic Parts of the same grade can be combined into one Random Relic Box of that grade (90%) or a random relic box of the next grade (10%) (not tradable).



Also, Sealed Relic Parts can be recycled into relic dust, which is used for upgrading relics (see below).

  • (1GR) Gold Relic

UPGRADING RELICS

Navigation for relic upgrade menu:

Relics can be upgraded to +1, +2, +3, improving their stats. Relics are upgraded linearly (first +0 to +1, then +1 to +2, then +2 to +3). If an upgrade fails, the relic DOES NOT decrease its current upgrade level.

Bonus from relic upgrade:
  • +1 = stats increase by 20%
  • +2 = stats increase by 50%
  • +3 = stats increase by 100%
Relic upgrade chance:

To upgrade relics, the resource Relic Parchment is required.

GUILD POINTS

You can find the current Guild Point ranking *at this link*
You can find information about additional guild bonus *at this link*

Guild Points are fixed every 2nd Friday. After points are fixed, they are reset to zero. Guild points for Friday received after the points are fixed are carried over to the next 2-week period.
Guild points update every day from 23:59 to 01:00 Moscow time (22:00 GMT, 05:00 WIB).

How can you obtain guild points? -
Guild Points for two weeks (24.10- 06.11):

1. War for Resources:
  • Each guild member attending CW can bring a maximum of 10 points to their guild;
  • If a guild member lands the last hit on the chip and then delivers the HSK — the guild will receive 500 points;
  • If a guild member kills the HSK of an enemy race — the guild will receive 500 points.
2. Killing Pit Bosses:

3. Completing Dungeons:
  • For each completed BD 46-50, each party member will receive 1.5 points for their guild;
  • For each completed BD Small Citadel, each party member will receive 3 points for their guild;
  • For each completed BD 50-55, each party member will receive 5 points for their guild;
4. For Quests
  • Solo Dungeon Quests of BD reward shards [10kk quests]
    • For each completed dungeon quest (solo quests), a player will bring 1 guild point to their guild.
  • Cartella quests:
    • For each completed medium quest, a player will bring 5 guild points to their guild.
  • Adventurer quests:
    • For each completed random adventurer quest, a player will bring 2 guild points to their guild.
    • For each completed experienced adventurer quest, a player will bring 3 guild points to their guild.
5.1 For killing "EXP" mobs
exp mobs in EXP dungeons do not bring guild points. Only mobs at locations bring guild points.
Phase 1 Monsters:
  • Giant Baba (Cauldron) — 0.5 guild points or 150 guild points per hour from all babas at location;

GUILD STORE

You can find the current guild store assortment *at this link*

The Guild Store is a unique module for purchasing in-game items using accumulated Guild Points, which are transferred to the guild store balance of the Guild Leader* every 2 weeks (along with payouts), provided the Guild ranks in the top 10 of the guild rating for its race.
*If there are 2 guild leader characters on an account, points will be credited only for the guild that accumulated more of them.

Only the Guild Leader can make purchases in the Guild Store.

IMPORTANT! Points in the guild store must be spent within the next two weeks. Each new crediting of points to the guild shop balance resets previous savings.

All items in the Guild Store and their prices are set by the Cerberus Team for specific 2-week phases of game development.


GUILD SKILLS

You can find the current leveling of guild skills *at this link*

The Guild Leader can level up skills for their guild using unique guild experience, or temporary improve a guild skill using a special capsule for temporary guild skill increase (drops from Guild PBs [see below]).

Which buffs can be leveled:
  • Attack Bonus (not displayed in stats): [1%, 1.2%, 1.5%, 1.9%, 2.4%, 3%, 3.7%, 4.5%, 5.4%, 7%]
  • Damage Absorption Bonus: [1%, 1.2%, 1.5%, 1.9%, 2.4%, 3%, 3.7%, 4.5%, 5.4%, 7%]

  • Economic Bonus (Additional % of points received by the guild (for shop and ranking)): [1%, 1.3%, 1.6%, 2.2%, 3.4%, 5.8%, 8%, 11%, 14%, 20%]
  • HP Bonus: [1.1%, 1.4%, 1.8%, 2.7%, 4.2%, 5.1%, 6.1%, 8%, 10.3%, 14%]

Cost of leveling guild skills:
Guild skills (buffs) are leveled up via guild experience.
(see below) Guild experience can be obtained by completing 1) general guild quests 2) individual guild quests 3) from guild PBs 4) as a reward for Cartella quests
Amount of guild experience required to level up a skill:
  • Level 1 — 100
  • Level 2 — 250
  • Level 3 — 600
  • Level 4 — 1050
  • Level 5 — 1750
  • Level 6 — 2600
  • Level 7 — 3800
  • Level 8 — 4200
  • Level 9 — 4700
  • Level 10 — 5000


GUILD QUESTS

1. General Guild Quest.

Progress for the general quest is counted for all guild members. You can view quest progress in the guild skill leveling menu *at this link*.
For example, a guild was given the general quest "Kill 500 Calianas". To complete this quest, all players in the guild must kill a total of 500 calianas during the day. This could be 1 character killing 500 calianas, or 10 characters killing 50 calianas each.

There are two types of general quests: Daily and Weekly. One daily quest is available per day, and one weekly quest is available per week.
  • Reward: 200 guild experience for the general daily quest.
  • Reward: 400 guild experience for the general weekly quest.
If the guild fails to complete the general quest, once the duration expires, the quest will reset and the Guild will receive a new one.


2. Individual Guild Quests.

Individual guild quests are completed by each player separately. You can obtain this quest from the Main Guild Curator in HQ.

There are two types of individual quests: Daily and Weekly. A daily quest can be obtained once a day, and a weekly one — once a week. For completing the quest, the player receives a guild experience capsule, as well as BD reward shards.

The higher the character's level, the higher the value of the guild experience capsule for completing the quest.

Guild experience reward for the daily individual quest:
BD reward shards are given at all levels except 45-49.
  • Level 45–49 — 1
  • Level 50–54 — 4
  • Level 55–59 — 6
  • Level 60–66 — 10

Guild experience reward for the weekly individual quest:
BD reward shards are given at all levels except 45-49.
  • Level 45–49 — 2
  • Level 50–54 — 10
  • Level 55–59 — 14
  • Level 60–66 — 24
Each Guild has a limit on completing individual guild quests.
For daily quests, the limit is 50 individual guild quests. The limit resets every day at 00:00 Moscow time (21:00 GMT, 04:00 WIB).
For weekly quests, the limit is also 50 individual guild quests. The limit resets every Monday at 00:00 Moscow time (21:00 GMT, 04:00 WIB).


GUILD PBS

Guild Pit Bosses are special PBs that drop capsules for temporary improvement of guild skills.
All temporary guild skill capsules last for 3 hours.

Available Guild PBs:
All guild PBs have a respawn time of 6 hours.
  • Experienced Baba. Location — Cauldron center, drop — Temporary guild EXP increase capsule ("guild EXP potion") +15% EXP.
  • (starting from 2nd week of Stage 1.1) Lucky Lazhuardian. Location — Crag Mines center, drop — Temporary guild drop increase capsule ("guild luck potion") +20% drop.
  • (starting from Stage 1.2) Builder Upsilon. Location — Outposts, drop — Temporary guild attack increase capsule ("guild attack potion") +N% attack.
    • Spawn location in Armory 213 — Death Valley, coordinates: 25 43.
    • Spawn location in Solus — Crawler Wood, coordinates: 63 57.
    • Spawn location in Haram — Crimson Coast, coordinates: 80 43.
  • (starting from 2nd week of Stage 1.2). Builder Omicron. Location — Ether Platform, drop — Temporary guild attack increase capsule ("guild attack potion") +N% attack and Temporary guild HP increase capsule ("guild HP potion") +N% HP.
  • (starting from Stage 1.3) Shaman Desert Traveler. Location — Sette Desert Center, drop — Temporary guild HP increase capsule +N% HP and Temporary guild absorb increase capsule +N% absorb.
  • (starting from Stage 2.1) Swamp Klan. Location — GC, drop — Temporary guild crit. increase capsule +N crit. and Temporary guild HP increase capsule +N% HP.
  • (starting from Stage 3.1) Naroom Renegade. Location — OL, drop — Temporary guild absorb increase capsule +N% absorb and Temporary guild attack increase capsule +N% attack.

Guild skill boosting works on a "+ effect amount" logic, not "+ skill level," and does not depend on the current guild skill level.
Using multiple identical capsules does not stack the effect or duration. Reusing an identical capsule will result in it being wasted.

For example, the drop bonus from a guild skill is:
  • Level 1 — 1%;
  • Level 2 — 2%;
  • Level 3 — 3%;
  • Level 4 — 5%;
  • Level 5 — 7%;
  • Level 6 — 10%;
  • Level 7 — 14%;
  • Level 8 — 19%;
  • Level 9 — 24%;
  • Level 10 — 30%.
Example 1.
A guild has leveled the drop bonus skill to Level 6, which gives a 10% drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 25% drop bonus: 10% from the Level 6 skill + 15% from the temporary capsule.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will only have the 10% drop bonus from the Level 6 skill.

Example 2.
A guild has leveled the drop bonus skill to Level 10, which gives a 30% drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 45% drop bonus: 30% from the Level 10 skill + 15% from the temporary capsule.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will only have the 30% drop bonus from the Level 10 skill.

Example 3.
A guild has Level 0 for the drop bonus skill, so the guild receives no drop bonus. Then the guild uses a temporary guild skill improvement capsule for +15% drop. As a result, the guild receives a 15% drop bonus.
When the temporary capsule effect expires, the guild will have a 0% drop bonus from the Level 0 skill.

CW takes place 3 times a day:
  • Morning CW: 06:00 - 06:40 Moscow time (03:00 - 03:40 GMT, 10:00-10:40 WIB)
    • on stage 1.1 06:00 - 08:00 Moscow time (03:00 - 05:00 GMT; 10:00 - 12:00 WIB)

  • Evening CW: 22:00 - 23:20 Moscow time (19:00 - 20:20 GMT, 02:00 - 03:20 WIB)
    • on stage 1.1 22:00 - 00:00 Moscow time (19:00 - 21:00 GMT; 02:00 - 04:00 WIB)

Drop from Chip (Terminal) when winning:
  • Gold Points
  • Terminal Relic (4GR)

Bonus Buffs / Debuffs of CW:
  • Bonus Buff for winning with HMS - +3% / +6% / +9% (attack and defense)
  • Bonus Buff for winning without HMS - +3% / +6% /+9% (attack)
  • Debuff for defeat (your race's chip is destroyed) - -2% / -4% / -6% (attack and defense)
  • Debuff for defeat (the chip of another race was destroyed not by your race) - -2% / -4% / -6% (defense)
  • Bonus buff for Chip Holder Guild -+15% attack for the entire guild
  • Bonus buff for delivering Chip for Chip Holder - +30% defense

CW bonus for getting and for the maximum number of temporary PVP points:
  • During CW (see below for which ones), gain temporary PVP points has been increased and the maximum number of temporary PVP points per day in the Crag Mines location has been increased*.
    *bonus is not working in other locations
  • CW bonus is working for all evening CW, as well as on weekend afternoon CW. On weekends, the evening CW bonus is additionally increased.
  • CW Bonus for getting and for the maximum number of temporary PVP points:
    • Weekdays afternoon CW 18%
    • Weekdays evening CW 38%
    • Weekend afternoon CW 38%
    • Weekend evening CW 55%

Mining Ore:
You can dig ore during and after the CW with the victory of your race. There is no need to loot HMS for be able to minning. The mining speed depends only on the character level and does not depend on the location (the same mining speed at any point of ore extraction zone).


Mining Tool:
Ore mining takes place manually by minning out ore in the ore mining area in Crag Mines, i.e. character must be at the ore mining area and dig the ore. Mining tool and batteries for mining tool can be purchased from NPC Ore at HQ.

Available batteries for Mining Tool and level required for use:
  • x1 Battery, 48+
  • x2 Battery ,55+
  • x3 Battery, 65+

Unmanned Mining Tool (UMT):
Ore mining takes place automatically using UMT in ore mining zone in the Crag Mines, i.e. you install this device in the ore mining zone and it automatically digs ore without your presence (character must be online in the game).

UMT and batteries for UMT can be bought in the Cash Shop. To use UMT, you need an UMT Storage, which can be purchased for 250 platinum (gold) from NPC ORE in HQ.

Available UMT and batteries for UMT and the level required for use.

  • UMT 45+ level, has 150,000 HP

Auto-loot medal information:

The auto-loot medal is a unique module that allows you not to waste precious time picking up loot from the floor.
  • If you are without a party, but with a medal, the loot drops immediately into the inventory.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'Shared' - all loot drops on the ground.
  • If you are in a group, the loot is 'On the leader' and the leader with a medal, the loot drops into the leader inventory.

    • If the party member, whose turn it is to receive loot, is in a far distance, the loot drops on the ground.

  • The medal disappears as soon as the Premium Service period ends.
  • The medal does not work on any loot from Pit Bosses.
  • If you want to disable autoloot, just sell the medal to NPC. When you re-enter the game, the medal will automatically return to the inventory.
